address: piazza Matteotti 6, San Casciano dei Bagni, 53040, Italy
bio: Having arrived in the picturesque village of San Casciano, we recommend a charming walk through the cobbled streets to admire its perfect preservation. Next, in the main square, take a seat at Daniela's. The Tuscan menu offers homemade pastas and a small wine list that celebrates Tuscany, with an international twist such as Greystone's 2016 Thomas Brother Pinot Noir. Among the delicacies on offer, you will find pici all'aglione, pappardelle al cinghiale, porchettato rabbit and grilled veal tenderloin: in short, a choice for all tastes! The cosy rooms are carved out of old stone spaces, and the outdoor terrace offers partial views of the bucolic landscape surrounding the village....
